text: A SaaS analytics platform for e-commerce store owners. Users connect their Shopify or WooCommerce store over OAuth and see dashboards for revenue, top products and conversion funnels. Stripe billing with a Starter tier at $29 and a Pro tier at $99, team invitations with editor and viewer roles, and CSV export. Next.js and Postgres on Vercel. Budget is $40k, MVP in 8 weeks, and we count it a success at 50 paying customers in the first three months.
notes: The reference rich brief: eight of nine parameters answered, only non-functional requirements missing. The domain is SaaS even though the customers run e-commerce stores, because the product sold is subscription software.
